metadata.description: Official viral.app plugins for coding agents: connect the viral.app MCP server and get skills for UGC reporting, Creator Hub workflows, viral research and event automations.

plugins.name: viral-app
plugins.description: Connect viral.app to your agent: OAuth MCP server with 100+ tools for UGC analytics, account and video tracking, tags, Creator Hub campaigns, briefs, job postings, applications, creator chat and payouts, the viral video library and live TikTok/Instagram/YouTube lookups, with interactive cards and event automations, plus five workflow skills.

plugins.name: viral-app-events
plugins.description: Claude Code only (channels research preview): pushes viral.app events such as new job applications, creator messages, payouts due, new videos and view milestones into a running Claude Code session so Claude can react. Needs the viral-app plugin for acting on events and a viral.app API key.
